cull-pit-001.name: The Cull Pit
cull-pit-001.blurb: The teams drop along the long edges, eleven inches apart, and every marker is on the centre line.

hab-warren-001.name: Warren of the Broken Hab
hab-warren-001.blurb: Collapsed hab-stacks over a contested court. Nothing here can be shot at from far away.

jungle-temple-001.name: Temple of the Green Moon
jungle-temple-001.blurb: A stepped ziggurat drowning in canopy. The sanctum is worth holding and has only four ways in — and the jungle between is Light terrain, so a Seek Light weapon can pick you out of it.

spacehulk-001.name: Derelict Hulk
spacehulk-001.blurb: A dead ship of welded wrecks. Five-inch corridors, blind junctions, and collapsed decking you shove through rather than shoot past.
